indicator_name: World Bank commodity prices, annual averages, nominal USD (Pink Sheet)
description: Мировые цены на сырьевые товары, годовые средние (Всемирный банк, Pink Sheet), номинальные $
unit: USD per unit named in item_name ($/bbl, $/mt, $/kg, $/troy oz …); NGAS_INDEX 2010=100
methodology: 69 series from 1960; the units row of the sheet is checked against dictionaries/wb_commodities.csv. File release: September 02, 2026.
